title: Captains Reach
author: Curious-Ad-7578
selftext: Built a maritime inspired MMO RTS game called CaptainsReach. Persistent browser based game with mix of different styles. Still in beta but already fully playable. You can try it out at captainsreach.com and share your thoughts

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Curious-Ad-7578 please add some details about how you used AI to develop this. Saying you used AI isn't enough on its own. We're looking for the actual dev details. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process and the actual development. We're trying to keep the sub from filling up with low quality game posts. If this doesn't get updated, it may be removed.

replies.author: Curious-Ad-7578
replies.body: Can I add the real link as well?

comments.author: Electronic-Movie4208
comments.body: That sounds awesome! 😄 A persistent browser based MMO is pretty ambitious. I'm developing my own RPG called Lanternwake, so I know how much work goes into these projects. I'll have to check yours out! Would love to exchange ideas sometime!

replies.author: Curious-Ad-7578
replies.body: Yes, it is still lot of work and process that needs to be understood in order to create a game on a shared world and that all works perfectly fine. Will check yours shortly!

replies.author: Electronic-Movie4208
replies.body: Absolutely! 😄 Building a shared world is no small task. Thanks for checking out Lanternwake! I'd love to hear your feedback when you get a chance. Always happy to connect and exchange ideas with fellow developers!

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body: The problem with mixing different styles is that so many poorly designed games already do it. Even if that’s the aesthetic you’re intentionally going for, people are likely to dismiss your game as just another poorly made amateur project.

replies.author: Curious-Ad-7578
replies.body: It is a different styles of genres since is including build and raid, solo missions, planned brotherhood alliances and not on graphic styles. Graphic style is pretty consistent . I appreciate your critique but you should give a try and play first, before giving generic response

replies.author: Xinnobun
replies.body: So.... different genres? because when you said "different styles" in your description, that could mean all sorts of things, usually art style.

replies.author: Curious-Ad-7578
replies.body: Different styles of play. You are right probably not clear on first spot. You can play game solo since have lot of solo missions and tasks,  and you can also play as mmorts or build and raid type of games. I played a lot of these games and usually was missing elements that some time wanted just to play without be involved in other parts of the game
